faq.title: XJ 508PS Questions Answered
faq.description: Answers about pricing, warranty, outputs and fitting for the supercharged Jaguar XJ 508PS engine.

faqs.q: How much is a Jaguar XJ 508PS engine replacement?
faqs.a: Pricing depends on the engine type, output and whether we carry out the fitting. Send your registration for an itemised written quote covering both parts and labour.

faqs.q: Do your 508PS engines include a warranty?
faqs.a: Yes. Every engine we supply carries a six-month mechanical warranty. We'll explain exactly what's covered and any conditions, including those for outside fitting, before you order.

faqs.q: Which 508PS outputs were fitted to the X351 XJ?
faqs.a: Parts catalogues list 471PS, 510PS, 550PS and 575PS versions for the X351 XJ. We identify yours from the VIN, so the replacement matches your car's original specification.

faqs.q: Was the 508PS fitted to the 1996 XJ?
faqs.a: No. The 1996 XJ range used six-cylinder and V12 engines, with the XJR using a supercharged six. The 508PS belongs to the X351 era, so we confirm your engine code first.

faqs.q: What are common Jaguar XJ 508PS engine problems?
faqs.a: Reported issues include supercharger coupling noise, timing chain tensioner wear, water pump and coolant leaks, and ignition faults. Symptoms overlap, so diagnosis should always come before any repair decision.

faqs.q: Can you deliver a 508PS to my own specialist?
faqs.a: Yes. Supply-only engines are delivered by pallet across the UK, to homes or independent garages. We confirm compatibility before dispatch and explain warranty conditions for third-party fitting.

faqs.q: What does your 508PS supply and fit service include?
faqs.a: At our Grays, Essex workshop we remove the failed engine, install the replacement, refill fluids, complete software setup and road test your XJ. Timescales are agreed when we quote.

workshopIntro.title: Repair or Replace: Getting It Right on Your 508PS
workshopIntro.description: Begin with a full diagnosis. Supercharger coupling noise, water pump leaks and coil faults are often repairable without touching the engine's internals. If chain failure or overheating has caused serious damage, weigh the repair estimate against your XJ's condition and value.
paragraphs: The Jaguar XJ 508PS engine replacement cost depends on the engine type, its output, its history and whether we fit it. A supercharged V8 swap is labour-intensive, so full supply and fit quotes provide the clearest and fairest comparison between suppliers.

When browsing 508PS 5.0 V8 supercharged petrol engine UK listings, ask which model and output the engine came from. Calibrations differ between tunes, so confirm mileage, history and pre-sale checks before you commit to buying.

Finally, check the warranty. A Jaguar XJ 508PS engine with warranty protects you if a mechanical fault develops after fitting. Engines we supply include a six-month mechanical warranty, and we explain its terms and any conditions before you order.

engineProblems.title: Jaguar XJ 508PS Engine Problems Worth Knowing
engineProblems.description: These symptoms might indicate a fault; diagnosis is needed to confirm.

cards.title: Supercharger Idle Chatter
cards.description: A rattle or chatter at idle that fades with revs may point to wear in the supercharger drive coupling.
cards.action: Ask for a supercharger drive check.

cards.title: Chain Noise on Start
cards.description: A brief rattle on a cold start could indicate worn timing chain tensioners, guides or associated components on either bank.

cards.title: Temperature Creeping Up
cards.description: A rising gauge or recurring coolant loss might suggest a water pump, thermostat housing or coolant pipe problem.
cards.action: Stop and arrange a pressure test.

cards.title: Charge Cooler Concerns
cards.description: Reduced performance or high intake temperatures could relate to the intercooler pump or low-temperature cooling circuit.
cards.action: Have the charge cooling system tested.

cards.title: Misfire Under Load
cards.description: Hesitation or a flashing engine light when accelerating hard may stem from ignition coils, spark plugs or injectors.

cards.title: Oil Leaks Appearing
cards.description: Oil on the engine or a burning smell after driving may indicate leaking cam cover, timing cover or sump seals.

engineOverview.title: How the 508PS Shapes Performance in the X351 XJ
paragraphs: The 508PS is the supercharged member of Jaguar's 5.0-litre AJ133 V8 family. Parts catalogues list it in the X351 XJ in several tunes, from 471PS up to 575PS in the XJR575, all driving the rear wheels. Direct injection and chain-driven camshafts are part of its design.

The entry tune is rated at 346kW, listed as 471PS, which is why searches for a Jaguar XJ 5.0 V8 supercharged petrol engine 471hp lead here. Higher-output 510PS and 550PS versions use the same engine code with different engine calibrations.

A Jaguar XJ 508PS engine 1996 search will not match, since the XJ then used six-cylinder and V12 engines. Even the 1996 XJR used a supercharged six-cylinder. The supercharged 5.0 V8 is an X351-era engine, so we always confirm the generation, output and engine code before quoting you.
